admin.definition: The people who manage an organization or a computer system; short for administration.
admin.example: The admin team helped the parent reset the password.

among.definition: In the middle of a group of people or things; surrounded by them.
among.example: She found her book among the cushions.

artsy.definition: Showing an interest in art, often in a showy way.
artsy.example: The artsy poster was covered in paint splashes.

axion.definition: A very light particle proposed by physicists.
axion.example: Scientists search for the axion in experiments.

bicep.definition: The large muscle at the front of the upper arm; usually called the biceps.
bicep.example: He flexed his bicep after lifting the box.

circa.definition: About or approximately, used with a date.

could.definition: The past tense of can; used to say someone was able to do something, or to make a polite request.
could.example: She could swim when she was four.

creme.definition: Cream, especially a thick sweet liquid or the best part of something.
creme.example: The dessert was topped with a spoonful of creme.

cutie.example: The puppy was a little cutie.

cyber.definition: Relating to computers, the internet, or virtual reality.

dilly.example: That new game is a dilly.

droit.example: The old law protected the lord's droit.

eking.definition: Present participle of eke; managing to make something last by using it carefully.
eking.example: They were eking out their supplies until help arrived.

femme.definition: A woman, especially in French or in phrases such as femme fatale.
femme.example: The character was a glamorous femme fatale.

fritz.definition: A state of being broken or not working, usually in the phrase on the fritz.
fritz.example: The old radio was on the fritz.

geeky.definition: Showing a lot of interest in technical or niche subjects.
geeky.example: He wore geeky glasses and loved computer facts.

girly.definition: Typical of a girl or showing traditional girliness (informal).
girly.example: She chose a girly pink backpack.

golly.definition: An exclamation of surprise or wonder.
golly.example: Golly, that was a big wave!

haute.definition: Fancy, high-class, or fashionable, used in phrases such as haute cuisine.
haute.example: The chef served haute cuisine at the hotel.

humph.definition: A sound made to show doubt, annoyance, or disapproval.
humph.example: 'Humph,' he said when he saw the muddy shoes.

hunky.example: The film star was tall and hunky.

hydro.definition: Water, or a hydroelectric power station (informal).
hydro.example: The town gets its power from the hydro.

hyper.example: The children were hyper after the party.

inbox.definition: The place where new emails or messages arrive.
inbox.example: She checked her inbox after lunch.

login.definition: The name and password used to enter a computer system; also the act of entering.
login.example: Enter your login to open the account.

manga.definition: Japanese comic books or graphic novels.
manga.example: He borrowed a manga from the library.

nerdy.definition: Showing great interest in technical or academic things, often in a way others find unfashionable.
nerdy.example: She told a nerdy joke about maths.

ombre.definition: A colour pattern that shades gradually from light to dark.
ombre.example: Her hair had an ombre effect.

ought.definition: Used to say what is right or expected.

piney.definition: Smelling or looking like pine trees.
piney.example: The forest path had a piney smell.

pouty.definition: Pushing the lips out in a sulky way.
pouty.example: The child gave a pouty face.

ralph.example: Ralph is a character in the story.

rebar.definition: Steel bars used to strengthen concrete.
rebar.example: Workers tied the rebar before pouring concrete.

recut.definition: To cut something again, especially a film or gemstone.

rehab.definition: Treatment to help someone recover from illness, injury, or addiction.
rehab.example: After the injury, she went to rehab.

roger.definition: Used in radio to mean 'message received'; also a boy's name.

shall.definition: Used to talk about the future, a promise, or a command.

shalt.definition: An old form of shall, used with thou.

since.definition: From a past time until now; or because.

terra.example: The plants grew in terra cotta pots.

these.definition: The plural of this; the things here.

those.definition: The plural of that; the things there.

turbo.definition: A device that makes an engine more powerful; short for turbocharger.
turbo.example: The car has a turbo engine.

twixt.example: The village lies twixt the hills.

unmet.example: The team had an unmet goal.

until.definition: Up to the time that something happens.

voila.definition: Look there! Used when showing something.

where.example: Where did you put your coat?

which.definition: Used to ask or say what one of a group.

women.example: The women rowed across the lake.

would.definition: The past tense of will; used to talk about a possibility or a polite request.
would.example: She would help if she could.

abled.definition: Having the ability to do something; not disabled.
abled.example: The path was designed for abled walkers and wheelchair users.
